name: E
note: Attempt E: the curriculum rebuilt around what the network can't do yet. Run D showed the easy stages destroy skill the exact copy already has (full wind: 90% at gen 0, 79% after calm air, 52% after the steady push; boulder 71% -> 38%), because selection only sees the easy world. So: start from the exact copy, train the weakness (the boulder) from calm air up to full wind, and fly 40% of every stage's training flights in the full final world (rehearsal) so nothing is forgotten.

stages.name: boulder, calm air
stages.expect: The pilot lands 95.6% here. The copy should get there; selection now sees the boulder in every flight.

stages.name: boulder, gusts
stages.expect: Steering around the boulder while gusts push sideways. Pass at 93%.

stages.name: everything
stages.expect: The full final world. Start level with the pilot (~71-77%); aim to pass it.

stages.name: polish
stages.expect: Everything on, only the env score + landing bonus. Pass = 98% on 100 + 100 fresh flights, then the 1,000-flight goal check.
